Led by Wasim M Ansari (IIT Madras Data Science alumnus, 8+ years experience), WSM AI SYS builds production-grade Generative AI agents, LangGraph workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Neo4j knowledge graphs, and high-performance bespoke 3D WebGL platforms.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. 3D Web Engineering & Spatial Interfaces
- **Description**: Ultra-high performance, zero-CDN, bespoke WebGL 3D interactive web experiences (procedural terrains, interactive product visualizers, dynamic particle systems, and hardware-accelerated shaders).
- **Tech Stack**: Native WebGL, GLSL Shaders, Three.js, Canvas API, Hardware Accelerated CSS, Zero External Dependency Architecture.
- **Key Advantage**: 100% self-hosted, lightning-fast load times (<1s LCP), 60+ FPS rendering across mobile and desktop.

### 2. Generative AI & Agentic Systems (LangGraph & MCP)
- **Description**: Autonomous multi-agent workflows, self-healing tool pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server development for enterprise tool integration.
- **Specialization**: LangGraph, LangChain, Anthropic MCP, Claude 3.5 Sonnet / GPT-4o / Gemini 1.5/2.0 API integrations, custom tool creation, human-in-the-loop validation.

### 3. Enterprise Hybrid RAG & Knowledge Graphs
- **Description**: Production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation combining semantic vector search (FAISS, Chroma, Qdrant) with structural graph databases (Neo4j).
- **Key Advantage**: Zero-hallucination domain intelligence, complex multi-hop entity reasoning, citation verification, and enterprise document ingestion.

### 4. Business Process Automation & MLOps
- **Description**: End-to-end operational automation replacing manual bottlenecks with intelligent async workers, CRM sync, WhatsApp/Email lead automation, and ERP forecasting modules.
- **Tech Stack**: FastAPI, Docker, Redis, Celery, Google Cloud Run, Azure AI, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI/CD.

### 5. Time-Series Demand Forecasting & Decision AI
- **Description**: Statistical demand modeling (Croston, TSB, Exponential Smoothing, LightGBM) and Monte Carlo confidence intervals for manufacturing and retail inventory optimization.

---

## Flagship Systems & Case Studies

1. **HyreFast Intelligence Layer**:
   - Full-stack AI recruiting engine with LangGraph, Neo4j, FastAPI, Redis, and MCP.
   - Normalized 12,000+ candidate skills across 40+ taxonomy dimensions with self-healing ingestion loops.
2. **Zovia Inventory Forecasting Engine**:
   - ERP-integrated intermittent demand forecasting engine with Monte Carlo simulations and automated reorder triggers.
3. **MediFlow & Clinical MCP Assistant**:
   - LangGraph multi-agent clinical assistant with hybrid FAISS RAG, LangSmith observability, and authenticated MCP tool execution.
4. **Alpine 3D Mountain Platform (WSM AI SYS)**:
   - Zero-dependency procedural 3D Himalayan WebGL mountain engine with real-time topographic contour shaders and fluid scroll flight physics.
